messages:
Amy: AtlasBank POC urgent: Rust client can't stream through their corporate TLS inspection. They also want a concrete func/tool JSON example for payments and a 1k TPS burst price ballpark. Anyone pick this up?

Tom: I'll take. Are they on hosted for the POC?

Amy: Yes hosted for now.

Eli: Common Rust TLS issue: native-tls rejects MITM certs. Quick workarounds: 1) Have Atlas add our egress IPs to allowlist, 2) for POC only, install our staging CA or provide CUSTOM_CA_PATH to SDK, 3) issue short-lived mTLS client certs for the POC. I can deliver a small SDK flag to accept a CA bundle for the trial.

Eli: Tiny streaming snippet (tokio + tungstenite):
```
use tokio_tungstenite::connect_async;
use futures_util::StreamExt;
async fn demo() { let (mut ws,_) = connect_async("wss://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream?model=rl-small").await.unwrap(); ws.send(Message::Text("{\"prompt\":\"charge $12.50 to acct-22\"}".into())).await.unwrap(); while let Some(m)=ws.next().await { println!("{}", m.unwrap()); } }
```
Eli: Example func-json tool response the model would emit for a payment: `{\"tool\":\"create_charge\",\"args\":{\"amount_cents\":1250,\"currency\":\"USD\",\"trace_id\":\"atlas-2026-03-21-001\"}}`

Rahul: Proxy gotchas: their proxy drops idle websockets at 30s. Recommend app-level pings every 15s and exponential reconnect. If allowlist not possible, we can provision a staging edge or mTLS certs. I'll list our egress IPs in the follow-up.

Sara: Security short: hosted uses AWS KMS (HSM-backed) by default; BYOK/on-prem HSM available for Dedicated/Private. SOC2 Type II & SAML/OIDC docs available. I'll DM the packet.

Tom (pricing): Rough hosted burst estimate for 1k TPS (avg 120 tokens) ~$18k-$30k/month. Dedicated sustained 1k TPS w/ SLA ~$55k-$85k/month. Can refine with payload sizes and caching.

ops-bot: Provisioned staging sandbox `atlasbank-poc-2061` with key `REDS_POC_2061` (expires 24h).

Amy: Thanks — scheduling a 30m sync with Atlas infra tomorrow 10am PT. Tom & Eli please join; I'll send invite and attach runbook.
